dishes.name: Berner Platte
dishes.desc: Platter of smoked pork, bacon, tongue and sausages on sauerkraut or beans, with boiled potatoes. The classic dish of the canton, served in traditional Bernese restaurants.

dishes.name: Zibelechueche
dishes.desc: Onion tart with cream, egg and nutmeg. Bern marks the autumn onion harvest with it, and bakeries and restaurants serve it around the Zibelemärit.

dishes.name: Mandelbärli
dishes.desc: Small bear-shaped almond sweets, a Bernese confectionery speciality. The bear is the city's emblem, so they are the typical local souvenir.

dishes.name: Rösti
dishes.desc: Grated potato fried into a golden cake, the traditional farmhouse side of the Bernese Mittelland. It goes with sausage, fried egg or a Berner Platte.

dishes.name: Meringues with double cream
dishes.desc: Crisp meringue shells with thick Gruyère double cream, a dessert of the Bernese Oberland and Emmental. Bern cafés and restaurants serve it as a regional treat.
